classification.difficultyReason: Select the base corresponding to the perpendicular height among redundant measurements; part c also requires consistent length units.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of these parallelograms.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram with horizontal bases, an interior vertical dashed altitude and matching parallel marks.
spec.mathematics: Base 14 km; perpendicular height 12 km; redundant sloping side 16 km. The altitude ends at the bottom-right vertex and is perpendicular to the horizontal base.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and altitude are permanent givens. The supplied area is retained only in the answer fields.

spec.description: Tall oblique parallelogram descending to the right, with an interior dashed perpendicular from its lower-left vertex to the right long side.
spec.mathematics: The 16 cm altitude is perpendicular to the 38 cm side. The 27 cm short side is retained as a redundant measurement. Long sides have single parallel marks; short sides have double marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and altitude are permanent givens. The supplied area is retained only in the answer fields.

spec.description: Tall narrow parallelogram with upper and lower pointed vertices and a dashed perpendicular from the left vertex to the opposite long side near the bottom.
spec.mathematics: The long side is 23 cm and its perpendicular height is 90 mm. The lower-left short side is 11 cm. Opposite long sides have single parallel marks and opposite short sides have double marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Mixed-unit measurements and altitude are permanent givens. The supplied area in square millimetres is retained only in the answer fields.

spec.description: Right-leaning parallelogram with horizontal bases and an external vertical double-ended height dimension to the right.
spec.mathematics: Base 1 cm; perpendicular height 1.8 cm; redundant sloping side 2.1 cm. The external dimension spans the top and bottom levels and has horizontal endpoint marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements are permanent givens. The supplied area is retained only in the answer fields.

spec.description: Parallelogram with vertical short sides and long edges descending to the right; its dashed altitude runs from the upper-right vertex to the lower long edge.
spec.mathematics: Long-edge base 7 cm; perpendicular height 2 cm; redundant vertical side 3 cm. Vertical sides have single parallel marks and sloping sides have double marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and altitude are permanent givens. The supplied area is retained only in the answer fields.

spec.description: Tall oblique parallelogram with short upper and lower edges descending to the right and a dashed perpendicular from its lower-left vertex to its upper short edge.
spec.mathematics: Short-edge base 11 mm; perpendicular height 16 mm; redundant long side 20 mm. Short edges have single parallel marks and long sides have double marks.
spec.answerVisibility: Measurements and altitude are permanent givens. The supplied area is retained only in the answer fields.
